privacy_intro: This policy explains what personal data whenweall collects, why, and what rights you have over it. We built whenweall to be as lightweight as possible — the data below is what running a scheduling tool actually requires, nothing more.
privacy_controller_title: Who is responsible for your data
privacy_controller_body: The data controller for whenweall is Refsdal Holding AS (org. no. 932 516 470), based in Oslo, Norway. If you have questions about this policy or want to exercise any of your rights, contact us at hello@whenweall.com.
privacy_data_body:
Account: your name, email address, a hashed password (or a link to your Google account if you sign in that way), and your language preference.

Organizations: the organizations and teams you create or join, membership roles, and the email addresses of people you invite.

Polls and sign-up sheets: titles, the date/time or text options you propose, and — from anyone who takes part — their name, votes, comments, and optionally their email address if you've asked participants to provide one.

Booking pages and bookings: the availability you configure, and — from anyone who books a slot — their name, email address, timezone, and any note they leave for you.

Support access: a small number of whenweall staff can look up your account and, where a support request or an abuse investigation requires it, lock, unlock, or delete it. Staff cannot sign in as you or view the service through your account. Every such action is recorded — who did it, to which account, when, and why. We do this on the basis of our legitimate interest in running a service that works and is not abused.
privacy_processors_body:
whenweall is self-hosted software. The operator running this instance chooses where it runs and which email (SMTP) provider delivers its mail.

Google is only involved if this instance has Google sign-in enabled — in that case Google processes the account data needed for sign-in, only for that purpose. Google Calendar sync is not available in this version.
privacy_purposes_title: Why we process your data, and on what basis
privacy_purposes_body:
We process account, organization, poll, and booking data to provide the service you asked for — this is necessary to perform our contract with you.

We send notification emails (like a comment on your poll, or a new booking) when you or a participant has asked to be notified, based on your consent.

We use Cloudflare Turnstile and similar checks to prevent abuse and spam, based on our legitimate interest in keeping whenweall usable.
privacy_retention_title: How long we keep your data
privacy_retention_body:
If you delete your account, it is genuinely deleted, not just deactivated. If you are the sole owner of an organization, deleting your account deletes that organization along with every poll, sign-up sheet, and booking page in it. If an organization has other members, ownership passes to one of them and the organization's content survives.

A poll, sign-up sheet, or booking page otherwise lives for as long as its organizer keeps it, or until the organization that owns it is deleted.
privacy_visibility_body: Names, votes, and comments on a poll or sign-up sheet are visible to anyone who has the link to it — that's what lets a group coordinate without everyone needing an account. Only share a poll link with people you're happy to have see who else responded and what they said.
privacy_cookies_body: We use a single session cookie to keep you signed in and to remember preferences like your language and theme. We don't use advertising or cross-site tracking cookies.
privacy_rights_body: Under the GDPR you have the right to access the personal data we hold about you, correct it, have it erased, receive a copy in a portable format, and object to how we process it. To exercise any of these rights, email hello@whenweall.com. If you're not satisfied with our response, you can complain to the Norwegian Data Protection Authority (Datatilsynet) at datatilsynet.no.

terms_service_body: whenweall lets you create scheduling polls, sign-up sheets, and booking pages, and share them with the people you're coordinating with. The service is free to use, and whenweall is open source.
terms_accounts_body:
You must be at least 13 years old to create an account, and the information you give us must be accurate. You're responsible for keeping your login credentials safe, and for anything that happens under your account.

Work you do together happens inside an organization. The owner (or owners) of an organization controls the organization's handle and whether it's deleted.
terms_acceptable_use_body: Don't use whenweall to post unlawful content, send spam, harvest other people's data, or impersonate someone else. We may remove content or suspend accounts that violate this.
terms_content_body: Whatever you create in whenweall — polls, sign-up sheets, booking pages, and the responses people leave — is yours. By using the service you grant us the license we need to host, store, and display that content in order to run whenweall. If you add someone else's email address to a poll or invitation, you're responsible for having their permission to do so.
